## Result and scope

Refs #54

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/54#issuecomment-6863792170, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-a9b8`.
- Outputs: `manuscript/existence/allarity-marked-propagation.tex`, `manuscript/existence/rank-root-normalization.tex` (one paragraph identifying the weight `a`), new record `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C13/large-weight-ADB991-claude-20261113-a9b8.md`. No other file changes.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

This addresses C13 open join 2 ("large marker weight") from `results/C13/completion-20261113.md`, which is also #109 part 3 M6 and obligation 2 of review #213. It is author-side work. ADB991 authored no other C13 chapter.

**What the source does.** One marker radius is used from the launch to the replica root: `Ship.allowance = exp(2·pot) = 𝓜_k^{1/(8M)}`. It is used as `Peak.Meter.radius` in `Peak.launched`, at every step of `Perch.covers`/`Perch.Exhibits`, and in `Soft.s_postage`/`Soft.coupon`. The launch pays `toll ≤ bill(1/8) = H^{1/8}` (`Peak.aperture`, `Peak.warming`). `Value.Notice.price` holds for every positive radius. The record has the declaration table with paths.

**What changed.**
- The propagation chapter now takes a general constant marker weight ω > 0. The only step that used r ≤ 1 was the realignment price; it now reads 2^n·max(1,ω)^n·R_e·y. Submultiplicativity of the weighted marker norm is proved for every ω > 0.
- New paragraph "The marker weight": ω = H^{1/(8u)}, H = 𝓜_k, at every level from the launch to the output torus. Since n ≤ u, ω^{|I|} ≤ H^{1/8}, so the discrepancy purchase becomes 2^n R_e H^{1/8} y ≤ H^{-q}. The text r = H^{1/(8u)-U}, the cost exponent U and the "cannot rescale" warning are removed.
- End of the envelope subsection: ω^{q_0|I|}|coefficient| ≤ exp{exponent + q_0(L+nℓ)}. With u = M, ω = e^{2I_k} = a, so this is exactly the coefficient price a^{q|I|} that `sec:rank-root-normalization` uses, with X ≤ 1+M. No rescaling is involved. rank-root-normalization.tex states the same identification.

**Remaining uncertainties.** These are explicit inputs at weight ω; see the record.
1. The one-step mixed-compiler outputs at weight ω. In the source this is the hypothesis `Perch.Exhibits`. I have not checked that the purchases in `actual-mixed-marked-compiler.tex` survive the H^{1/8} factor.
2. The per-step discrepancy now needs y ≤ 2^{-n}R_e^{-1}H^{-q-1/8}, a factor H^{1/8} stronger than before. Whether the reader estimate supplies this has not been checked.
3. The launch in `marked-healthy-cumulant-launch.tex` (not edited; outside the claim) must give its terminal purchase at weight ω ≥ 1. Its remark about "shrinking the marker radius" does not cover enlarging it. One sentence there would close this.
4. The manuscript runs the recurrence from the top level with realignment at every step. The source launches at the middle level and takes each step as a hypothesis. This revision does not reconcile the two organizations.
